_readme: Source of truth for every authored skill: beast skills, the avatar's active skills and passives, the skill-training materials, and each species' learnable skills and default loadout. A FIRST DRAFT for the balance simulator to correct, not confirmed balance. Edit here, then in Unity run Beast Craft/Data/Import Skill Library (after Import Beast Roster). Enums are member names (case-sensitive). Missing fields take the DTO defaults in SkillLibraryData.cs; note a missing TargetingCriterion means Distance (nearest), not Random. Damage Magnitude is power, a percent of the attacking stat; Heal is flat HP; a Shield is a percent of the caster's Defense; a DamageOverTime is a per-turn power; a Knockback is whole hexes. DefaultLoadout order is fire priority. The first 3 AvatarActives are the avatar's default actives. See docs/design/battle-system.md, 'Beast skill kits'.

Materials.Description: A sliver of crystallised battle essence. Feeds a skill a little XP; opens its first breakthrough (level 5).
A clear crystal of battle essence. Feeds a skill a good deal of XP; opens its second breakthrough (level 10).
The dense heart of a great battle's essence. Feeds a skill a large amount of XP; opens its final breakthrough (level 15).

BeastSkills.Description: A ponderous stone fist. Hits hard enough to matter, never hard enough to carry a fight.
The Golem plants itself and bellows; enemies within two hexes find they cannot look away.
Raises slabs of granite around itself and its neighbours: a shield worth part of the Golem's Defense.
A shoulder charge that sends the target skidding two hexes back.
Stamps the ground: everything within two hexes is shaken and may be slowed.
Hardens its hide: more Defense and Special Defense for three turns.
A crushing bite from the deep.
Churns the water into a whirlpool: enemies within two hexes are drawn to the Leviathan (taunted) and slowed.
Coils behind its scales and closes its wounds: a shield worth half its Defense and a small heal.
A wall of water down a three-hex line that may knock the front rank back.
A churning vortex around the Leviathan that wears down Special Defense.
A cool tide washes over allies within two hexes, healing them and hardening their guard.
A whip of thorned vine that leaves a festering wound (stacks three times).
Sap and leaf close the wounds of whichever ally within three hexes is worst off.
Grows a skin of bark over every ally within two hexes.
Roots burst from the ground and may hold the target fast for a turn.
Releases choking spores around itself: a lingering poison that also saps strength.
The whole team blossoms: a heal and a Defense boost.
A rending strike that cracks armour: -12% Defense for three turns, stacking up to three times.
The Tarasque brings its whole plated weight down on one foe.
Braces behind its plates and waits for the counterblow: more Defense and Attack for three turns.
Bristles its spines: a shield and a Special Defense boost.
Sheds a storm of metal scales at everything adjacent.
A two-hex charge that flattens the line and shoves the front of it back.
A shard of ice that chills: -8% Speed for three turns, stacking up to three times.
Encases the target in ice; it may be frozen solid for a turn.
A freezing exhalation over everything within two hexes; may chill (stacks three times).
Driving snow along all six axes, three hexes out.
Coats itself in rime: a shield and more Special Defense.
Once a battle, the air itself freezes: every enemy is struck and may be frozen.
Three quick electric rakes: many weak hits, each its own crit roll.
Lightning arcs between everything within two hexes, three times over: its answer to a swarm.
Builds a charge in its feathers: +15 crit chance and more Speed for three turns.
Opens the fight with a single dive from the clouds: one devastating hit, once per battle.
A deafening crack around itself that may stun.
Four bolts down a four-hex line.
A diving rake of talons.
A spear of compressed air down a three-hex line.
A beat of great wings that hurls everything adjacent two hexes away.
Rides the wind: harder to pin down (more Defense and Special Defense; there is no evasion stat) and one more hex of movement for two turns.
Lifts the whole team on a rising wind: more Speed and one more hex of movement.
A plummeting strike that tears through armour.
A bolt of flame that sets the target burning (stacks three times).
A sheet of fire down a four-hex line; may leave it burning.
Once a battle, the Phoenix wreathes itself in renewing fire: a heal and a large shield. There is no revive mechanic; this is the honest stand-in.
A concentrated lance of fire at up to four hexes.
Fire rains on every enemy and leaves them burning.
A cross of white fire three hexes out along every axis.
A spring of light wells up under the whole team and heals it.
Blesses the team: more Special Attack and Special Defense for two turns.
A bolt of pure light.
A pillar of light on one foe at up to four hexes: the Kirin's one real nuke.
Wraps the team in cleansing light. There is no cleanse mechanic: it is a shield and a Special Defense boost.
A ring of light heals and steadies every ally within two hexes.
Spits a venom that keeps working (poison, stacks three times).
Finds the most wounded enemy in reach and finishes it: up to +50% damage against a nearly dead target.
A glance that may turn the target to stone for a turn.
Four shadow bites in the blink of an eye: four crit rolls to find a weak point.
Narrows its eyes on the kill: +20 crit chance and more Special Attack for three turns.
A cross of poison fog three hexes out that lingers and weakens.

AvatarActives.Description: The avatar's war cry: +10% Attack and Special Attack for the whole team for two turns.
A gentle light that heals every beast a little.
Throws a shield over every beast, worth part of the avatar's Defense.
Curses every enemy: -10% Defense and Special Defense for two turns.
Sharpens the team's eye: +8 crit chance for two turns.
Thickens the air around the enemy: -12% Speed for two turns.

AvatarPassives.Description: Aura: every beast has +5 crit chance for the whole battle.
Aura: every beast has +5% Defense and Special Defense for the whole battle.
At the start of battle every beast gets a two-turn shield worth part of the avatar's Defense.
At the start of battle the team is quickened: +10% Speed for two turns.
At the start of battle every enemy is cursed: -10% Defense and Special Defense for three turns.
When an enemy falls, half the time the team surges: +10% Attack and Special Attack for two turns (at most every other avatar tick).
When a beast falls, the survivors rally: +15% Attack and Special Attack for three turns (twice a battle).
When a beast lands a critical hit, the avatar sometimes calls down a follow-up strike on every enemy.
Half the time a beast starts its turn, it recovers a little HP.
When a beast drops below 40% HP it is wrapped in a two-turn emergency shield (at most every other avatar tick).
